d:
Scarabee Sabre is actually Scarab Sable, however, the transliteration remains the same on the front cover and on most sites that have documented this rare book. It was only given out at the Komaba Festival and in limited quantities, though unlike most doujins in general, this work was limited to around 200 to 300 copies at best, if that. This work is extremely sought after as its one of the earliest known doujin works of Yu Kaimeiji (海明寺裕), who went on to be a very important mangaka. This work is heavily influenced on the works of Yoshikazu Yasuhiko and its been implied that Yas actually read and or owned a copy. This is a grail item of sorts for me as I have been searching for a copy for a few years now, so enjoy. This work is a copy book done on an early xerox with risograph printed covers.
